title: Fleet energy
subtitle: Estimated electricity use of your Sparks from GPU and CPU power telemetry. Not wall-metered.

reset.label: Reset…
reset.note: Power keeps being recorded from now on, and Monthly history is kept. This can't be undone.
reset.ask7d: Delete energy history older than 7 days?
reset.ask24h: Delete energy history older than 24 hours?

state.membershipBody: Sparks were added or removed since energy accounting started, so totals would no longer be comparable. Restart sparkDash to start a new accounting scope. Previous hourly history is withheld until then.
state.warmingBody: No complete energy interval has been recorded yet. Data appears here once every node has reported fresh power telemetry for a little while.

body.stale: Could not refresh just now; showing the last data received.
body.estimatedBody: Figures are integrated from GPU and CPU power readings and leave out power-supply losses and other components, so the wall draw is somewhat higher.

tiles.noEarlier: No earlier period to compare yet
tiles.setPrice: Set an electricity price in Settings
tiles.noTokenData: No token data in this range

noData.title: No energy recorded in the last {{range}}
noData.body: Try a longer range, or check that the Sparks are reporting power telemetry.

energyChart.subDay: kWh by node, local time, grouped by calendar day.
energyChart.ariaHour: Energy in kWh per hour by node, last {{range}}
energyChart.ariaDay: Energy in kWh per day by node, last {{range}}

powerChart.title: Average fleet power
powerChart.sub: Watts per hour while every node reported. Gaps mean no full-fleet coverage.
powerChart.aria: Average fleet power in watts per hour, last {{range}}

effChart.title: Efficiency
effChart.subHour: Wh per 1,000 generated tokens, per hour. Lower is better; idle time counts.
effChart.subDay: Wh per 1,000 generated tokens, per day. Lower is better; idle time counts.
effChart.ariaHour: Energy per 1,000 generated tokens per hour
effChart.ariaDay: Energy per 1,000 generated tokens per day

nodes.title: By node
nodes.sub: Each node is measured only while it reports, so coverage differs per node.
nodes.caption: Energy by node for the last {{range}}
nodes.costNeedsPrice: Cost needs an electricity price; set one in Settings.

insights.title: Insights
insights.empty: Insights appear once there is enough recorded data in this range.
insights.topNode: {{node}} uses the most energy: {{kwh}} kWh, {{pct}}% of the fleet total.
insights.topNodeAveraging: {{node}} uses the most energy: {{kwh}} kWh, {{pct}}% of the fleet total, averaging {{watts}} while reporting.
insights.peakAndLow: The highest-draw hour was {{when}} (local) at {{watts}}; the lowest was {{lowWhen}} at {{lowWatts}}.
insights.bestDay: {{day}} was the highest-use day with {{kwh}} kWh, {{pct}}% above the {{avg}} kWh average of well-covered days.
insights.nightLower: Overnight (22:00 to 06:00 local) the fleet averaged {{night}}, {{pct}}% lower than the {{day}} daytime average.
insights.nightHigher: Overnight (22:00 to 06:00 local) the fleet averaged {{night}}, {{pct}}% higher than the {{day}} daytime average.
insights.steady: Draw is steady around the clock: {{night}} overnight versus {{day}} during the day.
insights.weeklyCost: At {{price}} per kWh, this pace would cost about {{cost}} per week. This is a rough extrapolation from the data recorded so far, not a forecast.
insights.tokensPerKwh: The fleet generated about {{tokens}} output tokens per kWh ({{wh}} Wh per 1,000 tokens), counting idle time in the same hours.

about.title: About this data
about.estimatedBody: Energy is power telemetry (GPU + CPU) integrated over time, not a wall meter reading.
about.gapsBody: Hours with no telemetry are left out, never filled in. Coverage is the share of time every node reported fresh data; per-node coverage is in the table.
about.efficiencyBody: only counts tokens and energy from time when all nodes were reporting.
about.retentionBody: Hourly history is kept for 31 days. Longer ranges show what exists so far.
about.localTimeBody: Hours and days follow the time zone in Settings, or this browser's by default ({{timeZone}}). Hourly rows are stored in UTC.
about.membershipBody: Adding or removing a Spark starts a new accounting scope after a sparkDash restart.

monthly.title: Monthly history
monthly.sub: Totals per UTC month, kept permanently. They survive resets, restarts and changes to the fleet. Months are UTC, so they will not match a local-time electricity bill.
monthly.nothingArchived: Nothing archived yet. Each finished minute is added to its month once the Sparks have been reporting for a little while.
monthly.caption: Energy by node for {{label}}
monthly.footClosed: Only the Sparks that reported in {{label}} are listed. Coverage is the share of the month each one was measured. Estimated, not metered.
monthly.footOpen: Only the Sparks that reported in {{label}} are listed. Coverage is the share of the month each one was measured so far. Estimated, not metered.
